normativeBasis.meaning: Bind accepted component revisions, execute isolated consumers and upgrade/rollback gates, audit provenance and licenses, and publish only after actual future release authorization. The assembled signing-aware readback requirement is reported separately from local closure integrity.

Archive hashes do not authenticate a publisher. Signature, identity and semantic compatibility remain separate; reviewed service/workflow/ref, signer identity, subject and trust roots are required for actual release authentication.

Complete staged consumers precede public upload. A release is advertised only after every immutable destination package passes readback and complete destination consumption. Repository signing may alter only a verified signature envelope; unsigned entries and native hashes still must match.
